faq.q: How does brand analytics differ from Google Analytics?
a: Google Analytics tracks website behaviour. Brand analytics tracks how your brand is perceived: sentiment, share of voice, brand health metrics, competitive positioning, and offline impact (surveys, sales lift). Together they tell the full story.

faq.q: What data sources do you monitor?
a: Social media (organic + paid), news & PR, review sites, surveys, website analytics, sales data, and competitive digital presence. We synthesize signals into actionable brand intelligence.

Yes. We build attribution models (first-touch, multi-touch, time-decay) that connect marketing activities to revenue. In our attribution work, 60-70% of revenue typically traces back to non-direct sources once it is properly attributed.
